description: Electrical arithmetic and resistor colour codes — Computes Ohm's law and power from any two of V, I, R, P; series and parallel resistance with optional tolerance bounds; a voltage divider (with optional load); an LED series resistor rounded up to a preferred E-series value; conductor voltage drop from a caller-supplied resistivity; decodes or encodes 3 to 6 band IEC 60062 resistor colour codes; and tests whether a value is an official E3 to E192

bandCount.description: colour-encode: 3, 4 (default), 5 or 6 bands. 5 and 6 bands carry three digits.

bands.description: colour-decode: 3 to 6 colours read from the head end.

items.description: Colour name, head end first (IEC 60062 table).

claim.description: Optional map from an output value name (e.g. resistance, vout, minResistance) to the number you expect.

claimTolerancePct.description: Relative tolerance for claim values, percent (default 0: exact).

maxDropPercent.description: line-drop: fail when the drop exceeds this percent of supplyVoltage.

op.description: ohm | series | parallel | divider | led-resistor | line-drop | colour-decode | colour-encode | e-series.

rLoad.description: divider: optional load across r2, ohms.

resistance.description: ohm: ohms. colour-encode and e-series: the value in ohms.

resistivityOhmM.description: line-drop: conductor resistivity in ohm-metres, supplied by the caller (not looked up).

roundTrip.description: line-drop: count out and return conductors (default true).

series.description: led-resistor (default E24) and e-series: preferred-value series.

supplyVoltage.description: led-resistor: supply volts. line-drop: optional, enables dropPercent.

tcrPpm.description: colour-encode with 6 bands: temperature coefficient in ppm/K.

tolerancePct.description: series/parallel: shared tolerance percent for min/max bounds. colour-encode: tolerance percent to encode.

name: electrical-calc
